subject: POC Trial Planning: Success Criteria & Kickoff - Acme Industries
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Chen <alice.chen@acme.com>, Bob Liu <bob.liu@acme.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Mar 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Recap + Next Steps from today's discovery call - POC planning

Hi Alice and Bob,

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before we put a kickoff on the calendar.

Recap (from your ask):
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for Acme's customer support summarization pipeline (reduce avg handle time by 20% while keeping recall > 95%).
- Data: 6 months of anonymized support transcripts (~500k messages); POC will use subset (~50k) for initial evaluation.
- Success criteria (draft):
  * Avg response generation latency <= 300ms at 1k QPS equivalent
  * Summarization F1 >= 0.75 on agreed eval set
  * Deployment footprint <= 2x current per-tenant cost (TCO check)

Proposed POC plan + ownership:
- Kickoff: week of Mar 22 (propose Mar 25) — agenda: confirm success criteria, access plan, trial timeline. (Owner: Marissa)
- Data & access: Acme to share anonymized sample and S3 access by Mar 26. (Owner: Acme - Alice/Bob)
- Infra & config: Redwood to provision a dedicated trial instance + provide exportable eval harness by Mar 29. (Owner: Jonas)
- Weekly check-ins: 30-min calls (Wednesdays) to review metrics and blockers.
- Final readout: 3-weeks after kickoff, include technical summary + recommendation.

Attachments: I attached a one-page POC timeline and a success-criteria template for your edit. Please review and tell us if any of the target metrics are off.

Next steps:
1) Confirm kickoff date/time — we think Mar 25 10:00am PT works.
2) Alice/Bob to share sample dataset + IAM details by Mar 26.
3) Jonas will send setup notes and a runbook once access is available.

Thanks — excited to get started.

Best,
Marissa
Sr. Account Executive
Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0142

--

Subject: Re: Recap + Next Steps from today's discovery call - POC planning

Thanks Marissa — this looks good and aligned. A few clarifications from our side:

1) Success criteria: the latency target is aggressive but achievable; can we add a secondary "p95 latency" target (<= 600ms) for burst tolerance?
2) Data: we'll produce the anonymized sample (50k) and a separate 5k eval set with human labels by Mar 26. We'll share S3 read-only creds.
3) Security: we need your SOC2 attestation and an info-sec point-of-contact for the trial environment (we're running a security intake this week).

We'll confirm kickoff time once I check calendars — Mar 25 at 10:00am PT looks promising.

Thanks,
Alice Chen

Hi all,

Quick tech note to confirm provisioning and access plan:
- Trial instance: dedicated 2x A100 equivalent with 16GB KV cache, preloaded quantized model (Redwood-34B-q4) for initial runs.
- IAM: we'll need a read-only service role with S3 path access (s3://acme-poc/sample) and a temporary SSH key for debug access to the trial environment. No inbound allow from internet to private instance — we'll proxy via our secure tunnel and provide temporary credentials.
- ETA: instance up by Mar 27 EOD PT, baseline runs complete by Mar 29.

I'll share a short checklist (network, bucket path, sample manifest) in the Drive folder and ping Alice when the instance is ready.

Looking forward — planning note: if the eval shows >10% regression on recall we should pause and run a narrower hyperparam sweep before final readout.

Thanks,
Jonas Weber
